Well, let me say this, but I think that's the right solution I've had on the front lines, and the arguments we've made, and the logic is all on our side, if it weren't for the political, you know, if it weren't for the election, it wouldn't be a problem.
What they've done is, recently, within the last five or six days, they had a meeting
until three o'clock in the morning. All the Jewish organizations came out and said that
we should not agree on a trade agreement, that the Serbs should not represent the most
favored nation until there was some amelioration of the exit feast. So that's an accomplishment
on the part of the Jewish groups, all of them. They only had a hell of a trade agreement.
Now, this is just a sort of a hand-holding operation, and as soon as we announce the trade agreement, if they follow the plans, if they announce it, they'll announce it.
So I think all I can do is to try to indicate, as best I can, the arguments that you just made.
What do you think?

because I have a violent objection to one minority group holding the foreign policy
